age.Description: Not given per release subject (the article's Table 1 lists ages by article subject number 1-11, without the release IDs); cohort: 53-84 years, median 68

sex.Description: Not given per release subject; cohort: 3 female, 8 male (article)

handedness.Description: The article states all participants were right-handed

diagnosis.Description: Clinical indication for DBS (article: essential tremor, Vim thalamic DBS)

n_sessions.Description: Number of task sessions in the release

recording_type.Description: Electrodes recorded: macro contacts of microelectrode mapping tracks, or the implanted DBS lead (Medtronic 3387)

implant_type.Description: Recording electrode type. Deposit: channel labels macro_a/c/p/m (mapping electrodes, 4 subjects) vs dbs_01..08 (DBS leads, 7 subjects); paper Methods 'Electrophysiological recordings': mapping electrodes with a stainless steel macroelectrode ring (0.55 mm diameter, 1.4 mm length) 3 mm above the tip recorded with Neuro Omega (Alpha Omega); DBS leads Medtronic 3387 (4 Pt-Ir contacts, 1.27 mm diameter, 1.5 mm length, 1.5 mm spacing) recorded with Grapevine (Ripple).

recorded_hemisphere.Description: Hemisphere(s) of the recorded contacts, from contact_info.mat field side (and D.side in the session files). Paper: all but one subject underwent bilateral implantation (left first); one subject had right-side implantation only in this study.

n_contacts.Description: Number of distinct recording sites (contacts) with MNI coordinates in contact_info.mat for this subject (89 in total; paper Results: '89 recording sites'). Mapping-electrode subjects: one site per electrode per depth/session.

regions_sampled.Description: Paper: mapping electrodes and DBS leads targeted the Vim; contacts within/bordering VA+VLa (38/89) or VLp (51/89) by the Ewert atlas (paper Results). AAL3 lookup of the deposit MNI coordinates: all 89 in thalamus.
